description: Apply a change Cush proposed. Takes ONLY the token from an action_card block returned by cush_ask. SHOW THE HUMAN THE CARD'S BEFORE/AFTER AND GET THEIR AGREEMENT BEFORE CALLING THIS — it is the click, not the proposal, and it changes live selling settings. The token is single-use, expires in ten minutes, is pinned to the account and to the exact state the card described: if anything moved in between, this refuses with 'stale' rather than applying a change nobody read. Requires an admin (or owner) key.

token.description: The token from an action_card block — never construct or edit one

name: cush_confirm
title: Confirm a Cush action card
